name: Congruencia de Fase
description: Detecta edges and características using phase congruency in the dominio de frecuencia. This iluminación-invariant method reveals structural differences in AI content.
mechanism: Analiza phase alignment a través de multiple frequency scales. Phase congruency highlights structural características invariant to iluminación.
source: Morrone and Owens (1987), Pattern Recognition Letters
useCase: Detecting structural anomalías in generado por IA images

references.title: Kovesi, P. (2000). Phase Congruency: A Low-Level Image Invariant. Psychological Research.
Morrone, M.C. & Owens, R.A. (1987). Feature Detection from Local Energy. Pattern Recognition Letters.
Kovesi, P. (1999). Image Features from Phase Congruency. Journal of Computer Vision Research.

strengths:
• Contrast-invariant edge and característica detección
• Based on local energy model of característica perception
• Detecta edges regardless of iluminación changes
• Provides both edge strength and orientation
• Mathematically elegant frequency-domain approach
limitations:
• Computacionalmente costoso due to multiple filter responses
• Sensitive to noise in low-contraste regions
• Parameter tuning required for optimal results
• May miss texture-based anomalías
• Resolution-dependent performance
